prs.title: SM-578: recap feature backend
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Implements the full backend for a recap feature including AI narrative generation, schema migrations for two new fields, session logic, aggregation utilities, typed interfaces, and unit tests across 10 files — substantial but self-contained backend feature work.

prs.title: Sm 580 579 confetti and recap
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Builds on the backend from PR #529 and adds the complete frontend surface: a modal, celebration provider, multiple UI components, sandbox environment, real dashboard integration, and guided-experience wiring — a major feature spanning AI, UI, and data layers across 22 files.

prs.title: Support local dev against the staging Cognito pool
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Small config change adding a staging Cognito pool support for local dev via env example and a Terraform tweak — minor but purposeful infrastructure adjustment.

prs.title: Auto-confirm sign-ups in staging (Cognito for auth, DB for truth)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Introduces a new Lambda pre-signup trigger with its Terraform module (variables, main) and wires it into staging — modest but involves novel Lambda logic and infrastructure scaffolding.

prs.title: Confirm the app email on a Cognito forgot-password too
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Single-file fix extending the post-confirmation Lambda handler to also confirm the app email on forgot-password flows — small targeted logic addition.

prs.title: bootstrap: grant apply deployer kms:* for the Cognito email-sender key
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Single-file, single-concern IAM policy addition granting kms:* to the deploy role — trivial config tweak.

prs.title: Reroute all staging Cognito auth mail to the QA alias
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Builds a full custom Cognito email-sender Lambda with a build pipeline, multiple Terraform modules (main, outputs, variables, versions), CI/CD workflow updates, and Cognito module wiring — significant infrastructure feature despite vendored auto-gen being excluded.

prs.title: fix(deployment): stop the cognito branding plan from never converging
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Small fix across four Terraform files to resolve a non-converging Cognito branding plan, involving an import block and minor settings adjustments — simple but intentional infrastructure bug fix.

prs.title: feat(deployment): promote stagingx to be staging
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Promotes a full staging environment to production-parity with 135 files changed and 5728 custom lines spanning Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, networking, Cognito, SES, bootstrapping, and application config — a transformative architectural promotion representing weeks of infrastructure work.

prs.title: docs(prospects): developer onboarding guide + stale CRM/ACE doc refresh
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Delivers a comprehensive developer onboarding guide refresh and updates stale CRM/ACE docs across 18 files, with a handful of meaningful code touches in enrichment and HubSpot logic — solid documentation effort with some real code signal.

stories.name: Session Recap & Celebration Experience
stories.rationale: Built the end-to-end recap feature including backend logic and the frontend confetti/recap UI to celebrate user milestones and summarize completed sessions.

stories.name: Staging Environment Promotion & Stabilization
stories.rationale: Promoted stagingx to become the primary staging environment and hardened its Cognito authentication setup including email routing, auto-confirmation, KMS permissions, and local dev support.

stories.name: Developer Onboarding & CRM Documentation Refresh
stories.rationale: Created a new developer onboarding guide and refreshed stale CRM and ACE documentation to improve team ramp-up and partner-facing accuracy.
